name: Beaten Work
overview: The Scriptures reveal that beaten work, particularly of metals like gold, was a precise and sacred craft used in the construction of holy objects within the tabernacle. The detailed descriptions in Exodus and Numbers emphasize how elements such as cherubim, candlesticks, and their intricate parts were made from one continuous piece of beaten gold, reflecting both the skill and reverence required in worship. This beaten work symbolizes the careful obedience to God's instructions and the sanctity of the items used in His presence.
